description: This file contains a partial class 'DynamoDBStorage' that acts as a wrapper around the AWS DynamoDB SDK, providing methods for table management, CRUD operations, batch processing, and transactional operations within the Orleans framework. It includes detailed logging and handles various authentication scenarios.

classes.name: DynamoDBStorage
classes.description: A partial class providing a comprehensive wrapper around AWS DynamoDB SDK for Orleans, supporting table creation, updates, deletions, CRUD operations, batch processing, and transactions with detailed logging and flexible authentication.

methods.name: InitializeTable
methods.description: Initializes a DynamoDB table, creating or updating it based on configuration.

methods.name: CreateClient
methods.description: Creates an AmazonDynamoDBClient instance based on provided credentials and service URL.

methods.name: GetTableDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description of a DynamoDB table.

methods.name: CreateTableAsync
methods.description: Creates a DynamoDB table with specified schema and optional TTL configuration.

methods.name: UpdateTableAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing DynamoDB table's schema, throughput, and indexes.

methods.name: TableCreateSecondaryIndex
methods.description: Creates a secondary index on a DynamoDB table.

methods.name: TableUpdateTtlAsync
methods.description: Updates the TTL attribute configuration for a DynamoDB table.

methods.name: TableWaitOnStatusAsync
methods.description: Waits until a DynamoDB table reaches a desired status.

methods.name: TableIndexWaitOnStatusAsync
methods.description: Waits until a specific index on a DynamoDB table reaches a desired status.

methods.name: DeleTableAsync
methods.description: Deletes a DynamoDB table.

methods.name: PutEntryAsync
methods.description: Creates or replaces an entry in a DynamoDB table.

methods.name: UpsertEntryAsync
methods.description: Creates or updates an entry in a DynamoDB table with optional extra expressions.

methods.name: ConvertUpdate
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of fields into a DynamoDB update expression and attribute values.

methods.name: DeleteEntryAsync
methods.description: Deletes an entry from a DynamoDB table.

methods.name: DeleteEntriesAsync
methods.description: Deletes multiple entries from a DynamoDB table in batch.

methods.name: ReadSingleEntryAsync
methods.description: Reads a single entry from a DynamoDB table.

methods.name: QueryAsync
methods.description: Queries multiple entries from a DynamoDB table based on key conditions.

methods.name: QueryAllAsync
methods.description: Queries all entries matching key conditions, handling pagination.

methods.name: ScanAsync
methods.description: Scans a DynamoDB table with a filter expression.

methods.name: PutEntriesAsync
methods.description: Batch inserts or replaces multiple entries in a DynamoDB table.

methods.name: GetEntriesTxAsync
methods.description: Performs transactional reads of multiple entries.

methods.name: WriteTxAsync
methods.description: Performs transactional write operations including puts, updates, deletes, and condition checks.
